ICS 83.160; 59.060.01TXD 38Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard (Part 4) prescribes methods for determination of amount of dip on man-made fibre tyre yarns, cords and tyre cord fabrics treated with resorcinol formaldehyde latex (RFL) dip solution.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated as in Annex A.
